dataset: HIFLD Electric Substations (U.S. Department of Homeland Security, Homeland Infrastructure Foundation-Level Data)
access_note: The official HIFLD download is listed as restricted on data.gov (https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/electric-substations). This file comes from a public ArcGIS re-host of the HIFLD layer; records keep HIFLD SOURCE and SOURCEDATE fields.
coverage: Substations at 69 kV and above; lower-voltage distribution substations are incomplete.
